// CHAOS-5156: closes a gap self-found while diagnosing #2269's r1 void
// round (independently verified against real lizard 1.23.0 before
// fixing). stateClassDeclaration used to accept an underscore-prefixed
// token as a class/record name -- real lizard's own predicate
// (_state_class_declaration, java.py) only accepts alphabetic first
// characters, so a record named with a leading underscore never gets
// its name captured, and its compact constructor is therefore NOT
// exempted from scoring (the exemption requires the candidate name to
// equal the captured class_name, which stays empty here). Measured
// directly against real lizard 1.23.0: complexity 1 (real lizard
// reports one pseudo-function from the un-exempted compact-constructor
// body's own "if" condition, not a true function -- this is lizard's own
// quirky-but-real behavior for this construct, not something this port
// should "improve" on).
record _R(int x) {
    _R {
        if (x > 0) {
            x = x;
        }
    }
}
